desc: Parse input, build adjacency lists, and compute `deg[v]` for all vertices.
Derive the snowflake feasibility condition and prove the kept-size formula `kept = 1 + x*(y+1)` with `y <= deg(b)-1` for every chosen blue neighbor.
Implement per-center evaluation: for each `r`, collect `a_b = deg(b)-1`, sort descending, and scan `x = 1..deg(r)` while `a_x >= 1` to update `max_kept` with `1 + x*(a_x+1)`.
Handle edge cases: endpoints as centers, `x=1`, `y=1`, vertices with no eligible neighbors, and the guarantee that at least one snowflake exists.
Validate complexity and memory for `N=3e5`, use fast I/O and 64-bit-safe arithmetic even though values fit in int.
Produce final stdout answer as `N - max_kept` and run local sanity checks against the provided samples before submission.
